import collections

def transform(grid):
    counts=collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background={v for v,_ in counts.most_common(3)}
    color=max((v for v in counts if v not in background), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    return [[color]*3 for _ in range(3)]
for d in (d1,d2,grid):
    print(collections.Counter(sum(d,[])).most_common(), transform(d))
